attempted_axis: LOCAL-COUNT RECONSTRUCTION on ProcessEffects: our source declared SIX scratch vectors the original did not have as separate locals (inner-scope lightpos/delta/enemyDelta plus a function-scope normal, and `dir` was being reused as the impact vector at five sites). It is now referenced exactly ONCE, as argument 2 of CritterExpCollide, so it never gets a load or store -- only a single `addi rX,r1,68` address-take -- yet it still reserves 12 bytes, which is what holds our frame at 760 instead of 752 and pushes hitpos to slot 80 where target has it at 76. Target's corresponding call passes slots 116/92/104 = (pos, dir, delta), i.e. the original had no fourth vector there. Removing it is therefore certainly the right END STATE, but the direct removal is measured-dead twice at real 2163: deleting the declaration changes the local count, which re-orders the whole pre-loop f64 constant-hoist block (the failing diff is dominated by prologue lis/stfd/lfd/addi churn at T[6:104], not by the call site). NEXT LEVER, not yet probed: keep the declaration count constant while removing the vector -- e.g. substitute a same-size dead local, or find which OTHER site the original fed from `normal` so the variable earns its slot legitimately. Also still open below slot 92: our absdy bit-trick scratch sits at 52 where target has it at 20, and the bosspos vector at 36-44 where target has 56-64, so the sub-92 ordering differs even once the count is right.
